overview_description.description: TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. Tetra OS integrates the Data Foundry, Use Case Factory, Tetra AI, and Sciborgs into a single, AI-native platform. Together, these capabilities turn fragmented scientific data and workflows into governed, reusable, and compounding intelligence across discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience is trusted by leading biopharma organizations and ecosystem partners including NVIDIA, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Databricks, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft. For information, visit tetrascience.com.

product.name: Tetra Scientific Data and AI Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based platform that collects, unifies, contextualizes, and engineers scientific data into AI-native datasets for life sciences and drug discovery.

product.name: Chromatography Insights
product.description: An enterprise-scale dashboard that unifies chromatography data from multiple vendors and sites for real-time monitoring and analysis.

product.name: Tetra Data Platform
product.description: A cloud-native data management platform that automates ingestion, processing, and contextualization of scientific data for analytics and AI.

product.name: Tetra Sciborgs
product.description: A team of scientific and data experts who assist organizations in identifying use cases and optimizing scientific data workflows for AI readiness.

product.name: Tetra File-Log Agent
product.description: A software agent that automates the upload, contextualization, and management of scientific data files from instruments to the cloud platform.

product.name: Tetra Data Capture App
product.description: A vendor-agnostic application that digitizes and automates routine lab data capture tasks, such as weighing workflows.
